name: iCloud
tagline: Connects Apple's calendar, mail, contacts and reminders into Grok with one app password
description: A community-built connector that wires Apple's iCloud services into the app: calendar, mail, contacts and reminders. Installation checkboxes let you pick which of the four you want, and a single Apple app-specific password handles the sign-in for whichever you choose.
author: CyberZack42
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
